segments.name: Franchise Brands
segments.description: Franchises automotive repair and paint brands.
segments.evidence: Franchise Brands Our Franchise Brands segment consists of a diversified portfolio of brands including Meineke, Maaco, CARSTAR, ABRA, Fix Auto, 1-800 Radiator, Uniban, and Automotive Training Institute ("ATI") and serves retail, commercial, and insurance customers through 2,699 total locations as of December 27, 2025.
